note: Routing cases for /design, /engineer, /database and the experience-architecture diagnose skill. See README.md for fields and how to run them.

cases.request: /design this pricing page kind of stinks, tell me why
cases.context: A built page and a running app or its code.

cases.request: /design build a landing page for my reading list app
cases.context: Who the page is for. PRODUCT.md, or /impeccable init first if Impeccable is installed.

cases.request: /design the type on the blog feels off
cases.context: The blog's styles.

cases.request: /design I need dark mode and the contrast is bad
cases.context: The current color tokens.

cases.request: /design this button and the toggles feel dead when you click them
cases.context: The component code.

cases.request: /design the error messages on the signup form are confusing
cases.context: The form and its messages.

cases.request: /design make the web app feel native on iPhone
cases.context: A web app, not a SwiftUI project.

cases.request: /design show me three different directions for the settings screen before we commit
cases.context: The current screen.

cases.request: /design polish the dashboard before we ship
cases.context: Run once with Impeccable installed and once without. Without it the router must say Impeccable is missing and name the fallback.

cases.request: /design set this project up so design work knows who our users are
cases.context: No PRODUCT.md. Without Impeccable the router must say there is no shipped equivalent and stop.

cases.request: /design fix the homepage
cases.context: Review or change? Which part? The router should ask one question and stop.

cases.request: /design be brutal about this onboarding flow, then fix the easy things
cases.context: The flow. /harsh-review ships in working-style; if that kit is missing, use /steve-jobs-design-review.

cases.request: /design rewrite this README so it doesn't sound like AI wrote it
cases.context: The README text.

cases.request: /design the sidebar and the tabs disagree about where you are, and Back loses my filters
cases.context: A structure and state problem. /design should point elsewhere in one line and stop.

cases.request: /design what happens to this table when names are really long or there are zero rows?
cases.context: The table component.

cases.request: /design people sign up and then never come back
expect: recipe:People sign up and drift away
cases.context: What the product does and its first-run flow.

cases.request: /design make it pop
cases.context: Which screen? Bolder look or more motion? Asking once is the safer pass.

cases.request: /design every animation in this app has a different speed, sort it out once and for all
expect: recipe:A motion system for the whole app
cases.context: Animation code with many durations and curves and no MOTION.md. /motion ships in motion-kit, a separate plugin from the same catalog; run once with it installed and once without.

cases.request: /design the sidebar stutters when it slides open on my phone
cases.context: The sidebar component. Both picks fix a frame-rate problem; /motion fix needs motion-kit installed.

cases.request: /engineer the totals on the dashboard don't match the spreadsheet we export from
cases.context: Repo and a read-only path to the data.

cases.request: /engineer there's a bug where saving twice creates two orders and I can't pin it down
cases.context: A way to reproduce or logs.

cases.request: /engineer tests are all green but production keeps breaking after deploys
cases.context: CI config and recent incidents.

cases.request: /engineer review my branch for security problems before I open the PR
cases.context: A branch with changes. /security-review is built into Claude Code; where it is missing, fall back to the T03 investigation.

cases.request: /engineer the agent's plan sounds too easy and I can't see what's wrong with it
cases.context: The plan.

cases.request: /engineer I want to build the export feature test-first
cases.context: The feature and where its tests live.

cases.request: /engineer are any of our dependencies abandoned or risky?
cases.context: Run with and without the Trail of Bits plugin. Without it the router names the plugin and gives an investigation prompt.

cases.request: /engineer the app is slow
cases.context: Which page or workflow, and since when? One question, or the general slowness investigation.

cases.request: /engineer the settings page looks cramped and the spacing is off
cases.context: A visual job. /engineer should point to /design in one line.

cases.request: /engineer our Postgres upserts write the same rows over and over and the bill went up
cases.context: A PostgreSQL problem. Pointing to /database or naming PG06 both pass.

cases.request: /engineer the CI takes 25 minutes and costs too much
cases.context: The workflow files.

cases.request: /engineer the same kind of date bug showed up again
cases.context: The previous fix.

cases.request: /database can we prove the revenue figure matches the source invoices?
cases.context: Read-only access to the database and the source.

cases.request: /database we're about to ship a migration that renames a column
cases.context: The migration file. No writes to production.

cases.request: /database there are way too many tables, views and triggers
cases.context: Schema access.

cases.request: /database the database bill doubled and CPU is high
cases.context: pg_stat_statements if enabled; say install separately if not.

cases.request: /database just make our database simpler and easier to trust
cases.context: A broad request with no single problem named.

cases.request: /database our MongoDB collection has duplicates
cases.context: Not PostgreSQL. The router should say /engineer fits better and stop.

cases.request: /database retries from the queue sometimes insert a row twice
cases.context: The ingestion code and table.

cases.request: When I open a shared link signed out it lands on the wrong project
cases.context: A running app URL. Model-invoked; read-only.

cases.request: Do we have too many pages? Settings and Preferences look like the same thing
cases.context: The route list.

cases.request: What font do you think works for a cooking blog?
cases.context: Ordinary design talk. /design must not start on its own.

cases.request: Can you explain what an index does in Postgres?
cases.context: A question, not a /database request.

cases.request: Refactor this function to use async/await
cases.context: A direct task. /engineer must not start on its own.

cases.request: Make the hero heading bigger
cases.context: A direct edit. Neither /design nor a review skill should start.
